outcome: perineal tears (grade I, II, III, IV)
cohort: Women undergoing vaginal deliveries at the Maternity Ward, Bjelovar General Hospital in Bjelovar, Croatia, between 1950 and 2010.
finding: The modified Ritgen maneuver was associated with a significant reduction in all grades of perineal tears over decades.
mod_finding: The described modification of the Ritgen maneuver, a specific delivery technique, resulted in a significant reduction of all grades of perineal tears over 60 years.
